mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO MST_HOLIDAY CII USING (
SELECT '${item.calendarId}' CALENDAR_ID, #{item.cdate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}null CDATE, ${item.isHoliday}null IS_HOLIDAY, '${item.createUser}' CREATE_USER, '${item.createDept}' CREATE_DEPT, current date CREATE_TIME, '${item.createUser}' UPDATE_USER, current date UPDATE_TIME FROM sysibm.SYSDUMMY1
) TEMP
ON(CII.CALENDAR_ID = TEMP.CALENDAR_ID AND to_char(CII.CDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') = to_char(TEMP.CDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CII.IS_HOLIDAY = TEMP.IS_HOLIDAY, CII.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, CII.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CALENDAR_ID, CDATE, IS_HOLIDAY, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) VALUES(TEMP.CALENDAR_ID, TEMP.CDATE, TEMP.IS_HOLIDAY, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME)
